topics.title: Static Type Annotations & Type Inference
topics.objective: Understand primitive types, array annotations, function signatures, and return type contracts.
topics.example: function greet(name: string, count?: number): string { return name.repeat(count ?? 1); }
topics.exercise: Convert an untyped JavaScript utility library into strictly typed TypeScript functions.

topics.title: Interfaces, Type Aliases & Union Types
topics.objective: Model complex domain entities using interfaces, readonly attributes, and discriminated unions.
topics.example: type ResponseState = { status: "success"; data: string } | { status: "error"; error: Error };
topics.exercise: Design a strongly-typed API response state model that exhaustively handles error cases.

topics.title: Generics & Constraints
topics.objective: Implement reusable type-safe data structures using generic type parameters and keyof constraints.
topics.example: function getProperty<T, K extends keyof T>(obj: T, key: K): T[K] { return obj[key]; }
topics.exercise: Create a generic in-memory Cache<K, V> container with expiration timestamps.

topics.title: Type Narrowing & Custom Type Guards
topics.objective: Differentiate runtime types using typeof, instanceof, and user-defined type predicates.
topics.example: function isEmployee(person: Person): person is Employee { return "employeeId" in person; }
topics.exercise: Implement a polymorphic event dispatch system that safely narrows payload interfaces.

topics.title: tsconfig Strict Configuration & Modern Compilation
topics.objective: Configure strict null checks, noImplicitAny, and target modern ECMAScript output.
topics.exercise: Configure a monorepo build setup with strict typing and incremental compilation.
